items.title_orig: It’s crazy how different 1994 was to 1999 despite only being 5 years away from each other
items.article_text:
you went from Nirvana Pearl Jam Alice and chains Tupac biggie gfunk rap people wearing flannels no one really having internet yet at least everyday people no one with cell phones etc
 to teen pop like Britany spears Christina Aguilera boybands and girl groups all over the place shinny y2k aesthetics everyone on the internet and chat rooms people starting to get mobile phones iMacs etc modern world we live in today honestly started in the tail end of the 90s
